name: contributor_id
description: Unique identifier of the contributor, assigned by DIME entity resolution
observations: Joins to the contribution and contributor_cycle tables

name: contributor_type
description: Whether the contributor is an individual or an organization

name: contributor_gender
description: Gender of the contributor
observations: Imputed by DIME from first-name gender ratios and gendered titles; not self-reported

name: is_corporation
description: Whether the contributor is a corporation or trade organization
observations: Applies to committees only; these donors are excluded from the CFscore estimation

name: contributor_cfscore
description: Common-space CFscore of the contributor
observations: Negative is liberal, positive is conservative. Donors who gave to a single recipient are assigned that recipient's ideal point

name: is_projected
description: Whether the contributor was projected onto the space rather than estimated within it
observations: Stored as 0 or 1 in the source. Value 1 covers corporate and trade-affiliated committees and donors who gave to a single recipient, whose scores are less reliable

name: number_distinct_recipients
description: Number of distinct recipients in the scaling that received contributions from the donor
observations: The number of observations behind the ideal point. Eight or more distinct recipients is typically enough for a reliable estimate

name: first_cycle_active
description: First election cycle in which the donor was recorded as active

name: last_cycle_active
description: Last election cycle in which the donor was recorded as active

name: most_recent_name
description: Name reported by the contributor on their most recent record

name: most_recent_address
description: Street address reported by the contributor on their most recent record

name: most_recent_city
description: City reported by the contributor on their most recent record

name: most_recent_state
description: Two-letter state abbreviation reported on the most recent record
observations: Includes territories and foreign codes, so it is not linked to the state directory

name: most_recent_zipcode
description: ZIP code reported by the contributor on their most recent record
observations: Five or nine digits depending on the filing

name: most_recent_latitude
description: Latitude geocoded from the most recent record

name: most_recent_longitude
description: Longitude geocoded from the most recent record

name: most_recent_occupation
description: Occupation reported by the contributor on their most recent record

name: most_recent_employer
description: Employer reported by the contributor on their most recent record

name: most_recent_transaction_id
description: Identifier of the contributor's most recent contribution record
observations: Joins to transaction_id in the contribution table

name: most_recent_transaction_date
description: Date of the contributor's most recent contribution record
